decisions.reason: As a flagship product line tightly aligned with the firm's core dental software strategy and launched into a growing market by a growing firm with R&D and slack, management would likely tolerate early uncertainty and keep it.

Because the education institute builds on existing training and customer relationships, its performance threshold is likely moderate and the firm would probably retain it unless it clearly falls short of aspirations.

The remote support tool fits the established support business and can be maintained with limited additional search costs, so a growing firm would more likely keep it while learning about demand than withdraw it quickly.
